item.artDescription: An engraving on this furniture shows <color=#D09B61FF>a chinchilla</color> giving birth to <color=#D09B61FF>a chinchilla</color>, who is bloody and crying. A group of rats sleep peacefully nearby. This depiction tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>the chinchilla</color> giving birth to <color=#D09B61FF>the chinchilla</color> on 4th of Jugust, 5503.

An engraving on this furniture portrays <color=#D09B61FF>a chinchilla</color> lying in bed next to her newborn, <color=#D09B61FF>a chinchilla</color>, who is already trying to pull himself around. Nine fletchers gaze upon the scene. The work seems to express scarcity. This portrayal tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>the chinchilla</color> giving birth to <color=#D09B61FF>the chinchilla</color> on 9th of Aprimay, 5503.

This furniture bears an artwork of <color=#D09B61FF>a chinchilla</color> lying in bed next to her newborn, <color=#D09B61FF>a chinchilla</color>, who is already trying to pull himself around. Two otters sleep peacefully nearby. Almost every shape in the image seems to be rectangular. Though few would expect it, a barracuda waits in the background. This illustration relates to <color=#D09B61FF>the chinchilla</color> giving birth to <color=#D09B61FF>the chinchilla</color> on 1st of Jugust, 5503.
This weapon is engraved with a depiction of the minor celebrity Yukiko. At the edge of the image are eight ellipses. The work is executed in an amateurish yet attractive style.

An engraving on this furniture shows <color=#D09B61FF>Daina Allens</color> brutally hurting <color=#D09B61FF>Trogo Saastox</color> with a Mounted Twin M2HB Turret with quick, efficient movements. <color=#D09B61FF>Trogo</color> is wincing in agony. The work has an impressionistic feeling and a triangular structure. This representation tells the story of the attacking of <color=#D09B61FF>Trogo</color> on 10th of Decembary, 5500.

This furniture is engraved with a portrayal of <color=#D09B61FF>Grigory Newton</color> being crippled with cold efficiency. <color=#D09B61FF>Grigory</color>'s eyes are closed. There is an elder behind the focal point. This illustration relates to the disabling of <color=#D09B61FF>Grigory</color> on 11th of Aprimay, 5500.
This furniture bears a depiction of a goblin wearing a formal shirt. The scene takes place in the middle of a settlement.
This weapon is engraved with a portrayal of a solitary villager near a pond. The style is blocky with classical elements.
This furniture bears a portrayal of a bluejay holding a revolver. The work suggests the concept of happiness. In addition to that, the scene takes place inside a district built near a stone.

This furniture is engraved with a portrayal of <color=#D09B61FF>Fredrik 'Baffe' Backlund</color> trudging through sand and covered in sweat. The scene takes place inside a blazing desert. This illustration relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Baffe</color> overheating on 5th of Aprimay, 5500.
